items.summary:
It was discovered that Sudo did not properly handle time-based access
restrictions when sudoers rules used NOTBEFORE or NOTAFTER with
timestamps omitting the trailing timezone indicator. A local attacker
could possibly use this issue to execute commands outside the intended
time window by manipulating the TZ environment variable.
